target.title: [codex] Add Even Hub glasses bootstrap identity
target.body:
Related: #98227

## What Problem This Solves

Resolves part of the Even G2 / Even Hub glasses node proposal by adding the smallest Gateway-side bootstrap identity slice for discussion.

Even G2 is a product name, so this PR keeps the runtime/platform metadata broader: `platform: "even-hub"`, `deviceFamily: "glasses"`, and `modelIdentifier: "Even G2"`.

## Why This Change Was Made

This is intentionally smaller than the broader policy/docs preview in solavrc/openclaw#2. It does not import the Even Hub app, change node command policy defaults, enable Canvas plugin defaults, or add platform docs.

The shipped shape only:

- accepts `openclaw-even-g2-node` as a Gateway client id;
- allows matching Even Hub glasses metadata to use the existing native setup-code bootstrap path;
- keeps spoofed/mismatched metadata on the owner-approval path;
- keeps native/browser UI origin checks applied to the UI role;
- updates the plugin SDK API baseline for the exported client id surface.

## User Impact

No behavior changes for existing users unless a client connects with the new Even Hub glasses client id and matching metadata.

For Even G2 node development, this provides a concrete minimal seam for maintainer review before any app import, node command policy defaults, Canvas defaults, or docs are proposed.

## Evidence

Local validation:

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.gateway.config.ts src/gateway/server.auth.control-ui.test.ts src/gateway/server.ios-client-id.test.ts
pnpm plugin-sdk:api:check
```

AI-assisted: yes, Codex helped prepare the patch and run validation.


## Real behavior proof (2026-07-03)

Live, out-of-process proof against a gateway started from this branch
(`node scripts/run-node.mjs --dev gateway`, isolated `OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR`/`OPENCLAW_HOME`,
token auth). Setup codes were issued with the real CLI (`openclaw qr --json`) and a
standalone WebSocket client performed the full v3 device-auth connect handshake
(`connect.challenge` nonce, signed payload, `auth.bootstrapToken`). The client connected
with remote locality (`x-forwarded-for`), so silent local pairing cannot explain the results.

**Case A — genuine Even Hub glasses metadata → silent bootstrap approval.**
Client `{"id":"openclaw-even-g2-node","platform":"even-hub","mode":"node","deviceFamily":"glasses","modelIdentifier":"Even G2"}`:

```jsonc
// connect result (tokens redacted)
{
  "ok": true,
  "payload": {
    "type": "hello-ok",
    "auth": {
      "role": "node",
      "scopes": [],
      "deviceToken": "[redacted]",
      "deviceTokens": [
        {
          "deviceToken": "[redacted]",
          "role": "operator",
          "scopes": ["operator.approvals", "operator.read", "operator.talk.secrets", "operator.write"]
        }
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

Presence snapshot after connect shows the paired node:
`Node: openclaw-even-g2-node · platform even-hub · deviceFamily glasses · modelIdentifier Even G2 · mode node`.

**Case B — same client id, spoofed `deviceFamily: "watch"` → owner approval required.**

```jsonc
{
  "ok": false,
  "error": {
    "code": "NOT_PAIRED",
    "message": "pairing required: device is not approved yet",
    "details": { "code": "PAIRING_REQUIRED", "reason": "not-paired", "requestId": "2469936f-…" }
  }
}
```

**Case C — `node-host` client id with glasses metadata → owner approval required.**
Same `NOT_PAIRED` / `PAIRING_REQUIRED` shape (requestId `57362fb0-…`).

**CLI state after the three connects** (`openclaw devices list`, same isolated gateway):

```text
Pending (2)
  57362fb0-… device 5f0bf017…  roles: node; scopes: none   new pairing   ← Case C
  2469936f-… device 4111ed90…  roles: node; scopes: none   new pairing   ← Case B
Paired
  f8ba40a3…  roles node, operator
             scopes operator.approvals, operator.read, operator.talk.secrets, operator.write  ← Case A
```

Local validation on the rebased branch:

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.gateway.config.ts src/gateway/server.auth.control-ui.test.ts src/gateway/server.ios-client-id.test.ts  # 43 passed
pnpm plugin-sdk:api:check  # OK
```

## Note on the client id

`openclaw-even-g2-node` is the shipping external app's current id, but it bakes one hardware
generation into the wire-level registry while `platform: "even-hub"` / `deviceFamily: "glasses"`
stay generation-agnostic. If maintainers prefer a generalized id (e.g. `openclaw-even-hub`) per
question 3 in #98227, I will rename it here and in the external app before merge — the diff shape
does not change.
